title: IR sensor still: small object under crosshair, Iraq 2022
description: Infrared sensor frame from the Iraq 2022 unresolved UAP report (paired with video DOW-UAP-PR130-series): a small dark object sits under the targeting crosshair against a mottled thermal background, with orientation marker N, corner fiducials, redaction boxes (1.4a/1.4g) and a USCENTCOM MDR release footer.
